full_prompt_en: A square graphic portrait shows a wide-eyed, mustached man from the upper chest upward in dense black-and-white print. He turns over one shoulder toward the viewer, with slicked-back dark hair and a high, expressive brow. The eyes are opened unusually wide, becoming the strongest focal points in the face. A thin mustache begins at the upper lip and sweeps far outward in long curling tips, one extending toward the right edge. The mouth is closed and serious, making the startled gaze feel more theatrical. A dark suit jacket, light shirt collar, and narrow tie occupy the lower left and center. Behind the head, mustard-yellow rectangular blocks sit slightly off center, interrupted by pale paper margins and thin diagram-like ruled lines. Small scattered dots, crosshair marks, and distressed black patches give the background the look of a worked print rather than a clean photograph. The portrait's cheek, forehead, and neck are built from fine stipple and crosshatched tones, while eye outlines and hair remain bold black. The crop cuts the shoulders and much of the body, emphasizing the elongated mustache and strong facial expression. The viewpoint is close and nearly level, with the man's sideways body angle providing movement against the square graphic blocks. Light appears to come from the upper left of the monochrome portrait, lifting forehead and cheek while the neck and far side of the face turn darker; the yellow background stays flat and shadowless. No legible wording is present. The overall composition is witty and confrontational, balancing old-fashioned printed realism with stark modern yellow geometry and exposed draft marks.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形图形化人物像以密实黑白印刷表现一位从上胸部以上入画的阔眼蓄须男子。他越过一侧肩膀回望观者，深发向后梳起，眉弓高而富表情。双眼睁得异常大，成为脸上最强的焦点。细小胡须从上唇开始，向外扫成极长的卷曲尖端，其中一端伸向右边缘。嘴巴闭着且神情严肃，使惊愕目光更显舞台感。深色西装、浅色衬衣领和窄领带占据左下与中央。头后方偏离正中的芥黄矩形色块被浅纸边和细图解式标线打断。零散小点、十字准线与磨损黑斑让背景像经过经营的印刷品，而非干净照片。脸颊、额头和颈部由细点纹及交叉排线塑形，眼周轮廓和头发则保持浓黑。裁切去掉肩部及大部分身体，强调长胡须和强烈面部神情。视点贴近而近乎平视，身体的侧向角度在方形图形块前形成运动。单色人物像里的光似乎来自左上，抬亮额头与脸颊，颈部和脸的远侧转暗；黄色背景保持平坦无影。没有可读文字。整体构图机智而带对抗感，以旧式印刷写实平衡鲜明的现代黄色几何和裸露制图标记。
style_prompt_en: The image has a distressed graphic-print surface combining finely stippled grayscale modeling with flat opaque color blocks. Dark contours and dense hatching give the focal form crisp definition, while paper grain, rubbed ink, and stray drafting lines roughen the surrounding field. Black, off-white, graphite gray, and mustard yellow form a restricted, high-impact palette. Edges alternate between hard rectangular cuts and irregular printed marks; long thin curves can stretch across the negative space as a counter-rhythm. Light is modeled within the grayscale area through stipple density, while the colored blocks remain evenly flat. A close off-center crop creates pressure against broad open paper and simple geometry. The overall effect is eccentric, sharp, and tactile, placing antique tonal detail in a conspicuously modern layout.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有磨损的图形印刷表面，把细点纹灰阶塑形与平坦不透明色块结合。深轮廓和密排线让焦点形体定义清楚，纸纹、擦去的油墨与零散制图线则使周围色域变粗糙。黑、灰白、石墨灰与芥黄构成受限却强烈的色域。边缘在硬直矩形切口与不规则印痕之间交替；细长曲线可横穿负空间，形成反节奏。灰阶区域内部由点纹密度塑造光，彩色色块则保持均匀平坦。偏心近距离裁切在宽阔空纸和简单几何前制造压力。整体效果古怪、锐利且可触，把古旧调子细节放进醒目的现代布局中。
theme_en: A wide-eyed man with an extravagant mustache in black-and-white print over yellow blocks
theme_zh: 黄色色块前，一位眼睛睁大、胡须夸张的男子黑白印刷肖像
name: Salvador Dali
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
